newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 21,200 MT were 3 percent larger than the week earlier, but 63 percent below the 4-week average. The primary buyers were Mexico (9,900 MT--of which 8,400 MT was rough), Ghana (3,000 MT), Canada (2,300 MT), the Netherlands (1,300 MT), and Switzerland (1,000 MT).

Exports of 34,400 MT declined 52 percent from the previous week and 46 percent from the 4-week average. The major destinations were Japan (10,500 MT), Mexico (7,600 MT), El Salvador (3,900 MT), and Trinidad (3,800 MT).
